How we'll work together

Four clear steps, so you always know what happens next.

  1. 1

    Discover

    We talk through your business, your audience and your goals, so the design starts with the right answers.

  2. 2

    Define

    We agree the scope, the timeline and the price up front, so there are no surprises later.

  3. 3

    Design

    You get clear concepts to react to, then refinements until it feels exactly right.

  4. 4

    Deliver

    You receive final files ready for print and digital, so you can use them straight away.

One designer, from first sketch to final file.

Mungai By Design is a one-person studio. You work directly with me, so your ideas stay intact and every detail gets my attention.

These are the tools I use every day to turn a brief into finished work.

  • PhotoshopRetouching, compositing and realistic mockups.
  • IllustratorLogos and vector artwork that stay sharp at any size.
  • After EffectsLogo reveals and animated content.
  • FigmaLayouts, social kits and live feedback sessions with you.
  • Claude AIResearch, naming ideas and copy drafts that speed up the early stages.
  • CanvaFast, on-brand templates you can edit yourself.
  • CapCutQuick video edits for reels and short-form social.
